items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt: JJ Redick mentioned Ziaire Williams, Matisse Thybulle, Quentin Grimes, Cameron Carr, and Adou Thiero as players who will figure into the potential strength of the defense along with the obvious piece of Walker Kessler in a Wemby role: that is, keeping him "low and... by the basket"
